description: Lift the organization-wide newsletter opt-out of an email address, which may be in no audience, after the reader opted in again. consent_source records where and how, and is kept with the time. Audience statuses do not change: resubscribe an unsubscribed subscriber in their audience. Fails with a conflict while a bounce, complaint or manual suppression blocks newsletters to the address, and with not found when it has no opt-out. Needs audiences:write and a key not limited to some audiences.

consent_source.description: Where and how the reader opted in again, such as a reply asking to rejoin.

name: shipmail_resubscribe_newsletter_opt_out

newsletter_id.description: The newsletter the reader had unsubscribed from, when known.

opted_out_at.description: When the lifted opt-out was recorded.

title: Lift Newsletter Opt-Out
